description: Ask the fnlowl Advisor a question in plain English. It knows how fnlowl works — widgets and where each kind appears, the embed, sequences, campaigns, sending, credits, plans, MCP — and can read the account's own widgets, leads, analytics, campaigns, sequences and sending status to answer. Suited to "how does X work", "why is Y empty" or "what should I do next". It is read-only and spends an AI credit; a direct read tool is cheaper when the data needed is already known. Takes one self-contained question.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
